children: Energean delivered a strong operational recovery in Israel and is advancing the offshore Katlan field, Peel Hunt analysts write. Resilient cash generation and Katlan will help the London-listed energy company deliver its 2026 targets and set it up for future growth, the analysts write. Shares rise 8.3% to 857 pence.
